result.topic_en: A table of the coefficients of the products x(x+1)...(x+n-1) (unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind), used to compute the end coefficient 41/140 of the 7-point Newton–Cotes quadrature rule; a struck-out attempt at a substitution x = t + eξ heads the page.

methods.what: Table of coefficients of the expanded products x(x+1)...(x+n-1) (unsigned Stirling numbers of the first kind), rows n = 2 to 9
End coefficient of the 7-point Newton–Cotes rule obtained by integrating the Lagrange basis polynomial over [0,6], using the Stirling-number expansion
Arithmetic evaluation: factoring out 36 and summing positive and negative terms, giving the coefficient 41/140
Struck-out attempt at an expansion of φx under the substitution x = t + eξ
